dashboard.description: Task scheduler monitoring — success/failure rates, durations, running tasks, error tracking

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduler_runs WHERE started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') * 1000)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_code = 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) FROM scheduler_runs WHERE started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') * 1000)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduler_runs WHERE exit_code != 0 AND started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') * 1000)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) FROM scheduler_runs WHERE started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') * 1000) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL

SELECT date_trunc('hour', to_timestamp(started_at/1000)) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_code = 0) AS "Success", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exit_code != 0) AS "Failed" FROM scheduler_runs WHERE started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') * 1000) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT task_group AS metric, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) AS value FROM scheduler_runs WHERE started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') * 1000) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND task_group != '' GROUP BY task_group ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT to_timestamp(started_at/1000) AS time, task_id, exit_code, duration_ms, COALESCE(LEFT(error_tail, 80), '') AS error FROM scheduler_runs WHERE exit_code != 0 AND started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') * 1000) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT date_trunc('hour', to_timestamp(started_at/1000)) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Tasks" FROM scheduler_runs WHERE started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') * 1000) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT to_timestamp(started_at/1000) AS started, task_id, task_script, task_group FROM scheduler_runs WHERE status = 'running' ORDER BY started_at DESC
